question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Deliberate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Planned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Deliberate**: Characterized by or resulting from careful and thorough consideration. (जानबूझकर किया गया)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Casual**: Relaxed and unconcerned. (अनौपचारिक)
 
• **Hasty**: Done with excessive speed or urgency; hurried. (उतावला)
 
• **Planned**: Arranged, organized, or done in accordance with a plan. (आयोजित)
 
• **Rushed**: Done or completed too hurriedly; hasty. (जल्दी करना)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of '**Deliberate**' is 'Planned'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
